notes: Six independent fresh matches remain preferred, not a fixed minimum.
Exact confirmation count is 3 pending acquisition of reserved unacquired matches.
Two already-scored Gate B sources are exposed; they cannot be relabelled untouched holdouts.
One source is a case study. Reducing count never converts exposed sources into held-out ones.

development_pilot.label: development_pilot
development_pilot.rationale: Current recovery/diagnostic pair is two independent matches already used for design.

confirmation.label: small_sample_confirmation
small_sample_limits: n=3 cannot support a population-level tennis claim; report source-level intervals and treat superiority as provisional.
A 95% interval that includes zero is inconclusive, not a win.
If acquisition of the three reserved matches fails, do not substitute the two scored Gate B sources as untouched confirmation.

fallback_if_unacquired.label: report_deficit_do_not_relabel_exposed
fallback_if_unacquired.rule: Acquisition failure needs a prospective unused substitute and an updated manifest. The two scored Gate B sources remain development or historical observations.
